text.description_html:
Acorn PSPYP, Fish In Water Hand Painted Cabinet Knob

Hand painted on ceramic, this knob features a fish amidst waves. Acorn made, this decorative knob will be sure to brighten up your home with its arty style by adding a unique and colorful touch to any cabinet or drawer. It is 1-7/8 inches squared.

Features of the Hand Painted Fish and Wave Ceramic Cabinet Knob,:

  • Length: 1-7/8" square
  • Material: ceramic
  • Each design is hand painted on ceramic.
  • Package includes 1 knob and hardware for installation.

Sold Individually. Due to the hand painted nature of this product, the colors will vary slightly.
